examples.title: Double Helix
examples.description: Two strands twist down the 80-column screen, drawn with nothing more than PRINT, TAB and a row of equals signs.

examples.title: Day of the Week
examples.description: Type any date and the CBM 610 works out which day of the week it falls on, using Zeller's congruence; year 0 stops.

examples.title: The Last Match
examples.description: Take one, two or three matches in turn; whoever takes the last one loses, and the computer knows the trick.

manuals.title: Commodore B Series User's Guide
manuals.note: The user's guide for the CBM-II family, sold as the B series in North America, including Extended BASIC 4.0+. PDF scan.

manuals.title: Commodore 700 Reference Manual (1982)
manuals.note: Reference manual for the CBM-II family, written for the 700 models; the 610 runs the same BASIC 4.0+. Scan at the Internet Archive.
